source_units.text: Thus says the Lord God to My anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I grasped so that nations would heed him: “I will shatter kings’ strength, open doors before him, and cities will not be shut.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord God to My anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I grasped so that nations would heed him: “I will shatter kings’ strength, open doors before him, and cities will not be shut.

source_units.text: I will go before you and level mountains. I will shatter bronze doors and break iron bars.
source_units.display_text: I will go before you and level mountains. I will shatter bronze doors and break iron bars.

source_units.text: I will give you dark treasures and open hidden, unseen stores to you, so that you may know that I am the Lord God who calls your name, Israel’s God.
source_units.display_text: I will give you dark treasures and open hidden, unseen stores to you, so that you may know that I am the Lord God who calls your name, Israel’s God.

source_units.text: For the sake of My servant Jacob and Israel My chosen one, I will call you by your name and welcome you; yet you did not know Me.
source_units.display_text: For the sake of My servant Jacob and Israel My chosen one, I will call you by your name and welcome you; yet you did not know Me.

source_units.text: For I am the Lord God, and there is no god besides Me, and you did not know Me,
source_units.display_text: For I am the Lord God, and there is no god besides Me, and you did not know Me,

source_units.text: so that those from the sun’s rising and those from its setting may know that there is none besides Me. I am the Lord God, and there is no other.
source_units.display_text: so that those from the sun’s rising and those from its setting may know that there is none besides Me. I am the Lord God, and there is no other.

source_units.text: I fashioned light and made darkness; I make peace and create calamities. I am the Lord God, who does all these things.
source_units.display_text: I fashioned light and made darkness; I make peace and create calamities. I am the Lord God, who does all these things.

source_units.text: Let heaven above rejoice, and let clouds sprinkle righteousness. Let earth bring forth mercy and bring forth righteousness together. I am the Lord who created you.”
source_units.display_text: Let heaven above rejoice, and let clouds sprinkle righteousness. Let earth bring forth mercy and bring forth righteousness together. I am the Lord who created you.”

source_units.text: What better thing did I fashion like a potter’s clay? Will the plower plow the earth all day? Will the clay say to the potter, ‘What are you doing, since you neither work nor have hands?’
source_units.display_text: What better thing did I fashion like a potter’s clay? Will the plower plow the earth all day? Will the clay say to the potter, ‘What are you doing, since you neither work nor have hands?’

source_units.text: The one saying to the father, ‘What will you father?’ and to the mother, ‘What will you bring forth in labor?’
source_units.display_text: The one saying to the father, ‘What will you father?’ and to the mother, ‘What will you bring forth in labor?’

source_units.text: For thus says the Lord God, Israel’s Holy One, who made what is coming: “Ask Me about My sons and My daughters, and command Me concerning the works of My hands.
source_units.display_text: For thus says the Lord God, Israel’s Holy One, who made what is coming: “Ask Me about My sons and My daughters, and command Me concerning the works of My hands.

source_units.text: I made earth and humanity upon it. With My hand I established heaven; I commanded all the stars.
source_units.display_text: I made earth and humanity upon it. With My hand I established heaven; I commanded all the stars.

source_units.text: I raised him as king with righteousness, and all his ways are straight. He will rebuild My city and bring back My people’s captivity, without ransom or gifts,” said the Lord Sabaoth.
source_units.display_text: I raised him as king with righteousness, and all his ways are straight. He will rebuild My city and bring back My people’s captivity, without ransom or gifts,” said the Lord Sabaoth.

source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord Sabaoth: “Egypt toiled, and the Ethiopians’ trade; and the Seboin, tall men, will cross over to you and become your slaves. source_units.text: for Thou art God, and we did not know it, Israel’s God, the Savior.’”
source_units.display_text: for Thou art God, and we did not know it, Israel’s God, the Savior.’”

source_units.text: All who oppose Him will be ashamed and abashed and go away in shame. “Be renewed toward Me, islands.”
source_units.display_text: All who oppose Him will be ashamed and abashed and go away in shame. “Be renewed toward Me, islands.”

source_units.text: Israel is saved by the Lord with everlasting salvation. They will not be ashamed or ever be abashed for eternity.
source_units.display_text: Israel is saved by the Lord with everlasting salvation. They will not be ashamed or ever be abashed for eternity.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord who made heaven—He is the God who displayed the earth and made it, who marked it out; He did not make it for emptiness, but to be inhabited—“I am, and there is no other.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord who made heaven—He is the God who displayed the earth and made it, who marked it out; He did not make it for emptiness, but to be inhabited—“I am, and there is no other.

source_units.text: I have not spoken in secret or in a dark place of the earth. I did not say to Jacob’s offspring, ‘Seek a futile thing.’ I am, I am the Lord, speaking righteousness and announcing truth.
source_units.display_text: I have not spoken in secret or in a dark place of the earth. I did not say to Jacob’s offspring, ‘Seek a futile thing.’ I am, I am the Lord, speaking righteousness and announcing truth.

source_units.text: Gather and come; take counsel together, you who are saved from the nations. Those carrying wood as their carved image did not know, praying as though to gods who do not save.
source_units.display_text: Gather and come; take counsel together, you who are saved from the nations. Those carrying wood as their carved image did not know, praying as though to gods who do not save.

source_units.text: If they will announce it, let them draw near so that they may know together who made these things heard from the beginning. Then it was announced to you: I am God, and there is no other besides Me; there is none righteous and saving apart from Me.
source_units.display_text: If they will announce it, let them draw near so that they may know together who made these things heard from the beginning. Then it was announced to you: I am God, and there is no other besides Me; there is none righteous and saving apart from Me.

source_units.text: Turn back to Me, and you will be saved, you from the earth’s extremity. I am God, and there is no other.
source_units.display_text: Turn back to Me, and you will be saved, you from the earth’s extremity. I am God, and there is no other.

source_units.text: By Myself I swear: Surely righteousness will go out from My mouth; My words will not return, because every knee will bend to Me and every tongue will confess to God,
source_units.display_text: By Myself I swear: Surely righteousness will go out from My mouth; My words will not return, because every knee will bend to Me and every tongue will confess to God,

source_units.text: saying, ‘Righteousness and glory will come to Him,’ and all who set themselves apart will be ashamed.
source_units.display_text: saying, ‘Righteousness and glory will come to Him,’ and all who set themselves apart will be ashamed.

source_units.text: From the Lord all the offspring of Israel’s sons will be justified, and in God they will be glorified.”
source_units.display_text: From the Lord all the offspring of Israel’s sons will be justified, and in God they will be glorified.”

source_units.text: Bel fell; Dagon was shattered. Their carved images became a burden for wild and domestic animals. Lift them, bound together, as a load for one who is weary
source_units.display_text: Bel fell; Dagon was shattered. Their carved images became a burden for wild and domestic animals. Lift them, bound together, as a load for one who is weary

source_units.text: and hungry and exhausted, without strength at all; they cannot be saved from war, and they themselves were led captive.
source_units.display_text: and hungry and exhausted, without strength at all; they cannot be saved from war, and they themselves were led captive.

source_units.text: “Listen to Me, house of Jacob and all Israel’s remnant, you who are carried from the belly and instructed from childhood.
source_units.display_text: “Listen to Me, house of Jacob and all Israel’s remnant, you who are carried from the belly and instructed from childhood.

source_units.text: Until old age I am, and until you grow very old I am. I bear with you; I made you, and I will release you. I will take you up and save you.
source_units.display_text: Until old age I am, and until you grow very old I am. I bear with you; I made you, and I will release you. I will take you up and save you.

source_units.text: To whom did you liken Me? Look, devise your handiwork, you who wander astray.
source_units.display_text: To whom did you liken Me? Look, devise your handiwork, you who wander astray.

source_units.text: Those contributing gold from a pouch will set silver on a balance by weight; after hiring a goldsmith they made handmade objects and bend down to worship them.
source_units.display_text: Those contributing gold from a pouch will set silver on a balance by weight; after hiring a goldsmith they made handmade objects and bend down to worship them.

source_units.text: They lift it onto their shoulders and go along. If they set it down, it stays in its place and will never move. Whoever cries to it, it will certainly not listen or save him from evils.
source_units.display_text: They lift it onto their shoulders and go along. If they set it down, it stays in its place and will never move. Whoever cries to it, it will certainly not listen or save him from evils.

source_units.text: Remember these things and groan. Repent, you who have wandered astray; turn back in heart.
source_units.display_text: Remember these things and groan. Repent, you who have wandered astray; turn back in heart.

source_units.text: Remember the former things from eternity, for I am God, and there is none besides Me,
source_units.display_text: Remember the former things from eternity, for I am God, and there is none besides Me,

source_units.text: announcing the last things beforehand, before they came to be—and together they were fulfilled. I said, ‘All My counsel will stand, and I will do everything I have planned,’
source_units.display_text: announcing the last things beforehand, before they came to be—and together they were fulfilled. I said, ‘All My counsel will stand, and I will do everything I have planned,’

source_units.text: calling a bird from the east and from a distant land concerning what I have planned. I spoke and brought it about; I created and acted. I brought him and made his journey prosper.
source_units.display_text: calling a bird from the east and from a distant land concerning what I have planned. I spoke and brought it about; I created and acted. I brought him and made his journey prosper.

source_units.text: Listen to Me, you who have lost heart, who are far from righteousness.
source_units.display_text: Listen to Me, you who have lost heart, who are far from righteousness.

source_units.text: I brought My righteousness near, and I will not delay the salvation that comes from Me. I have given salvation in Zion to Israel for glory.”
source_units.display_text: I brought My righteousness near, and I will not delay the salvation that comes from Me. I have given salvation in Zion to Israel for glory.”

source_units.text: “Come down and sit on the ground, virgin daughter Babylon. Enter darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans, for you will no longer be called tender and pampered.
source_units.display_text: “Come down and sit on the ground, virgin daughter Babylon. Enter darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans, for you will no longer be called tender and pampered.

source_units.text: Take a millstone and grind flour. Uncover your veil, expose your gray hair, pull up your garments to bare your lower legs, and cross rivers.
source_units.display_text: Take a millstone and grind flour. Uncover your veil, expose your gray hair, pull up your garments to bare your lower legs, and cross rivers.

source_units.text: Your shame will be uncovered, and your reproaches will be visible. I will exact justice from you; I will certainly no longer hand it over to humans.”
source_units.display_text: Your shame will be uncovered, and your reproaches will be visible. I will exact justice from you; I will certainly no longer hand it over to humans.”

source_units.text: The One who rescued you said—His name is the Lord Sabaoth, Israel’s Holy One—
source_units.display_text: The One who rescued you said—His name is the Lord Sabaoth, Israel’s Holy One—

source_units.text: “Sit stricken and enter darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. You will certainly no longer be called a kingdom’s strength.
source_units.display_text: “Sit stricken and enter darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. You will certainly no longer be called a kingdom’s strength.

source_units.text: I was provoked against My people; you defiled My inheritance. I gave it into your hand, but you gave them no mercy; you made the elder’s yoke exceedingly heavy.
source_units.display_text: I was provoked against My people; you defiled My inheritance. I gave it into your hand, but you gave them no mercy; you made the elder’s yoke exceedingly heavy.

source_units.text: You said, ‘I will rule for ever.’ You did not consider these things in your heart or remember the last things.
source_units.display_text: You said, ‘I will rule for ever.’ You did not consider these things in your heart or remember the last things.

source_units.text: Now hear these things, pampered one who sits confident, saying in her heart, ‘I am, and there is no other. I will not sit as a widow or know bereavement.’
source_units.display_text: Now hear these things, pampered one who sits confident, saying in her heart, ‘I am, and there is no other. I will not sit as a widow or know bereavement.’

source_units.text: Now these two will come upon you suddenly, in one day: widowhood and childlessness will come suddenly upon you, amid your sorcery and the overwhelming power of your enchanters,
source_units.display_text: Now these two will come upon you suddenly, in one day: widowhood and childlessness will come suddenly upon you, amid your sorcery and the overwhelming power of your enchanters,

source_units.text: in your hope of wickedness. For you said, ‘I am, and there is no other.’ Know that understanding these things and your prostitution will become your shame. You said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no other.’
source_units.display_text: in your hope of wickedness. For you said, ‘I am, and there is no other.’ Know that understanding these things and your prostitution will become your shame. You said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no other.’

source_units.text: Destruction will come upon you, and you will certainly not know it—a pit, and you will fall into it. Misery will come upon you, and you will certainly not be able to become clean. Destruction will come upon you suddenly, and you will certainly not know it.
source_units.display_text: Destruction will come upon you, and you will certainly not know it—a pit, and you will fall into it. Misery will come upon you, and you will certainly not be able to become clean. Destruction will come upon you suddenly, and you will certainly not know it.

source_units.text: Stand now amid your enchantments and your abundant sorcery, which you learned from youth, if you can be helped.
source_units.display_text: Stand now amid your enchantments and your abundant sorcery, which you learned from youth, if you can be helped.

source_units.text: You have toiled in your counsels. Let heaven’s astrologers stand up and save you; let those watching the stars announce to you what is about to come upon you.
source_units.display_text: You have toiled in your counsels. Let heaven’s astrologers stand up and save you; let those watching the stars announce to you what is about to come upon you.

source_units.text: Behold, all will be burned up like brushwood upon a fire and certainly not rescue their soul from flame. Since you have burning coals, sit upon them!
source_units.display_text: Behold, all will be burned up like brushwood upon a fire and certainly not rescue their soul from flame. Since you have burning coals, sit upon them!

source_units.text: These will be your help! You toiled in your trade from youth; each person wandered on his own, but there will be no salvation for you.”
source_units.display_text: These will be your help! You toiled in your trade from youth; each person wandered on his own, but there will be no salvation for you.”

source_units.text: “Hear these things, house of Jacob, you called by Israel’s name, who came forth from Judah, who swear by the name of the Lord God of Israel, remembering without truth or righteousness,
source_units.display_text: “Hear these things, house of Jacob, you called by Israel’s name, who came forth from Judah, who swear by the name of the Lord God of Israel, remembering without truth or righteousness,

source_units.text: and cling to the holy city’s name and lean upon Israel’s God; His name is the Lord Sabaoth.
source_units.display_text: and cling to the holy city’s name and lean upon Israel’s God; His name is the Lord Sabaoth.

source_units.text: I announced the former things beforehand; they went out from My mouth and were heard. Suddenly I acted, and they arrived.
source_units.display_text: I announced the former things beforehand; they went out from My mouth and were heard. Suddenly I acted, and they arrived.

source_units.text: I know that you are stubborn, your neck an iron sinew and your forehead bronze.
source_units.display_text: I know that you are stubborn, your neck an iron sinew and your forehead bronze.

source_units.text: I announced it to you long ago; before it came upon you I made you hear it. Do not say, ‘My idols did it,’ or say, ‘My carved and cast images commanded me.’
source_units.display_text: I announced it to you long ago; before it came upon you I made you hear it. Do not say, ‘My idols did it,’ or say, ‘My carved and cast images commanded me.’

source_units.text: You heard everything, but you did not understand. Yet I also made you hear the new things from now on, what is about to happen, and you did not speak.
source_units.display_text: You heard everything, but you did not understand. Yet I also made you hear the new things from now on, what is about to happen, and you did not speak.

source_units.text: They happen now, not long ago; you did not hear them in earlier days. Do not say, ‘Yes, I know them.’
source_units.display_text: They happen now, not long ago; you did not hear them in earlier days. Do not say, ‘Yes, I know them.’

source_units.text: You neither knew nor understood; from the beginning I did not open your ears. For I knew you would utterly reject faithfulness, and you would be called lawless even from the belly.
source_units.display_text: You neither knew nor understood; from the beginning I did not open your ears. For I knew you would utterly reject faithfulness, and you would be called lawless even from the belly.

source_units.text: For My name’s sake I will show you My anger and bring My glorious deeds upon you, so that I do not destroy you.
source_units.display_text: For My name’s sake I will show you My anger and bring My glorious deeds upon you, so that I do not destroy you.

source_units.text: Behold, I sold you, but not for silver; I rescued you from a furnace of poverty.
source_units.display_text: Behold, I sold you, but not for silver; I rescued you from a furnace of poverty.

source_units.text: For My sake I will act for you, because My name is being profaned. I will not give My glory to another.
source_units.display_text: For My sake I will act for you, because My name is being profaned. I will not give My glory to another.

source_units.text: Listen to Me, Jacob and Israel whom I call. I am first, and I am for ever,
source_units.display_text: Listen to Me, Jacob and Israel whom I call. I am first, and I am for ever,

source_units.text: and My hand founded the earth, and My right hand established heaven. I will call them, and they will stand together
source_units.display_text: and My hand founded the earth, and My right hand established heaven. I will call them, and they will stand together

source_units.text: and all will gather and hear. Who announced these things to them? Loving you, I carried out your will against Babylon, to remove the Chaldeans’ offspring.
source_units.display_text: and all will gather and hear. Who announced these things to them? Loving you, I carried out your will against Babylon, to remove the Chaldeans’ offspring.

source_units.text: I spoke, I called; I brought him and made his journey prosper.
source_units.display_text: I spoke, I called; I brought him and made his journey prosper.

source_units.text: Draw near to Me and hear these things. From the beginning I did not speak in secret or in a dark place of the earth. When it came to be, I was there; and now the Lord has sent me, and His spirit.”
source_units.display_text: Draw near to Me and hear these things. From the beginning I did not speak in secret or in a dark place of the earth. When it came to be, I was there; and now the Lord has sent me, and His spirit.”

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord who rescued you, Israel’s Holy One: “I am your God. I have shown you how to find the road on which you will walk.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord who rescued you, Israel’s Holy One: “I am your God. I have shown you how to find the road on which you will walk.

source_units.text: If you had listened to My commands, your peace would have become like a river and your righteousness like a sea wave.
source_units.display_text: If you had listened to My commands, your peace would have become like a river and your righteousness like a sea wave.

source_units.text: Your offspring would have become like sand, those born from your belly like the earth’s dust. Even now you will certainly not be destroyed, nor will your name perish before Me.”
source_units.display_text: Your offspring would have become like sand, those born from your belly like the earth’s dust. Even now you will certainly not be destroyed, nor will your name perish before Me.”

source_units.text: Leave Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans. Announce a voice of rejoicing, and let this be heard; proclaim it to the earth’s extremity. Say, “The Lord rescued His slave Jacob.”
source_units.display_text: Leave Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans. Announce a voice of rejoicing, and let this be heard; proclaim it to the earth’s extremity. Say, “The Lord rescued His slave Jacob.”

source_units.text: Even if they thirst, He will lead them through a wilderness and bring water out of a rock for them. A rock will split and water will flow, and My people will drink.
source_units.display_text: Even if they thirst, He will lead them through a wilderness and bring water out of a rock for them. A rock will split and water will flow, and My people will drink.

source_units.text: “There is no rejoicing for the ungodly,” says the Lord.
source_units.display_text: “There is no rejoicing for the ungodly,” says the Lord.

source_units.text: Listen to me, islands, and attend, nations. “After a long time it will stand,” says the Lord. From my mother’s belly He called my name,
source_units.display_text: Listen to me, islands, and attend, nations. “After a long time it will stand,” says the Lord. From my mother’s belly He called my name,

source_units.text: and made my mouth like a sharp sword. In the shelter of His hand He hid me; He made me a chosen arrow and sheltered me in His quiver.
source_units.display_text: and made my mouth like a sharp sword. In the shelter of His hand He hid me; He made me a chosen arrow and sheltered me in His quiver.

source_units.text: He said to me, “You are My slave, Israel, and in you I will be glorified.”
source_units.display_text: He said to me, “You are My slave, Israel, and in you I will be glorified.”

source_units.text: I said, “I toiled in vain and gave my strength to futility and nothing. Therefore my judgment is with the Lord, and my toil before my God.”
source_units.display_text: I said, “I toiled in vain and gave my strength to futility and nothing. Therefore my judgment is with the Lord, and my toil before my God.”

source_units.text: And now thus says the Lord, who formed me from the belly as His slave to gather Jacob and Israel to Him—I will be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and my God will be my strength—
source_units.display_text: And now thus says the Lord, who formed me from the belly as His slave to gather Jacob and Israel to Him—I will be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and my God will be my strength—

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord who rescued you, Israel’s God: “Sanctify the one who despises his own life, the one abhorred by nations—the slaves of rulers. Kings will see him and rise; rulers will bow to him because of the Lord, for Israel’s Holy One is faithful, and I chose you.”
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord who rescued you, Israel’s God: “Sanctify the one who despises his own life, the one abhorred by nations—the slaves of rulers. Kings will see him and rise; rulers will bow to him because of the Lord, for Israel’s Holy One is faithful, and I chose you.”

source_units.display_text: saying to those in bonds, ‘Come out,’ and telling those in darkness to be revealed. They will be fed along all their roads, with pasture along every path.

source_units.display_text: They will neither hunger nor thirst, nor will scorching heat or the sun strike them. Rather, the One showing them mercy will comfort them and lead them through springs of water.

source_units.display_text: I will make every mountain into a road and every path into pasture for them.

source_units.display_text: Rejoice, heavens, and let earth exult! Let mountains burst out in joy and hills in righteousness, for God had mercy on His people and comforted His people’s lowly ones.

source_units.display_text: But Zion said, “The Lord has abandoned me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”

source_units.display_text: “Will a woman forget her child, failing to have mercy on the offspring of her belly? Even if a woman forgets these, I will not forget you,” said the Lord.

source_units.display_text: “Behold, on My hands I painted your walls, and you are before Me continually.

source_units.text: You will swiftly be rebuilt by those who pulled you down, and those who laid you waste will depart from you.
source_units.display_text: You will swiftly be rebuilt by those who pulled you down, and those who laid you waste will depart from you.

source_units.text: Lift your eyes around and see them all. Behold, they gathered and came to you. As I live, says the Lord, you will put them all on and wrap them around you like a bride’s adornment.
source_units.display_text: Lift your eyes around and see them all. Behold, they gathered and came to you. As I live, says the Lord, you will put them all on and wrap them around you like a bride’s adornment.

source_units.display_text: For your deserted, destroyed, and fallen places will now be cramped by inhabitants, and those swallowing you will be removed far from you.

source_units.display_text: For your sons whom you lost will say within your hearing, ‘This place is too cramped for me. Make room for me, so I can settle.’

source_units.text: You will say in your heart, ‘Who bore these for me? I was childless and widowed. Who raised these for me? I was left alone; where were these of mine?’”
source_units.display_text: You will say in your heart, ‘Who bore these for me? I was childless and widowed. Who raised these for me? I was left alone; where were these of mine?’”

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: “Behold, I lift My hand toward nations and will raise My signal toward islands. They will bring your sons in their bosom and carry your daughters on shoulders,
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “Behold, I lift My hand toward nations and will raise My signal toward islands. They will bring your sons in their bosom and carry your daughters on shoulders,

source_units.text: and kings will be your foster fathers and ruling women your nurses. They will bow to you upon the earth’s surface and lick the dust of your feet. You will know that I am the Lord, and you will not be ashamed.
source_units.display_text: and kings will be your foster fathers and ruling women your nurses. They will bow to you upon the earth’s surface and lick the dust of your feet. You will know that I am the Lord, and you will not be ashamed.

source_units.text: Will anyone take spoils from a giant? If someone takes captives unjustly, will he be saved?”
source_units.display_text: Will anyone take spoils from a giant? If someone takes captives unjustly, will he be saved?”

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: “If someone captures a giant, he will take spoils; one taking from a strong man will be saved. I will judge your case, and I will rescue your sons.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “If someone captures a giant, he will take spoils; one taking from a strong man will be saved. I will judge your case, and I will rescue your sons.

source_units.text: Those who afflicted you will eat their own flesh, drink their own blood like new wine, and become drunk. All flesh will perceive that I am the Lord who rescued you and upholds Jacob’s strength.”
source_units.display_text: Those who afflicted you will eat their own flesh, drink their own blood like new wine, and become drunk. All flesh will perceive that I am the Lord who rescued you and upholds Jacob’s strength.”

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord: “What is your mother’s divorce document with which I sent her away? Or to which debtor have I sold you? Behold, you were sold because of your sins, and I sent your mother away because of your lawless acts.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “What is your mother’s divorce document with which I sent her away? Or to which debtor have I sold you? Behold, you were sold because of your sins, and I sent your mother away because of your lawless acts.

source_units.text: Why did I come when no person was there, call when no one obeyed? Is My hand not strong enough to rescue? Am I not able to deliver? Behold, by My threat I will make the sea desolate and turn rivers to deserts; their fish will dry up for lack of water and die in thirst.
source_units.display_text: Why did I come when no person was there, call when no one obeyed? Is My hand not strong enough to rescue? Am I not able to deliver? Behold, by My threat I will make the sea desolate and turn rivers to deserts; their fish will dry up for lack of water and die in thirst.

source_units.text: I will clothe heaven in darkness and make its covering like sackcloth.”
source_units.display_text: I will clothe heaven in darkness and make its covering like sackcloth.”

source_units.text: The Lord gives me a tongue of instruction, to know the right time when a word must be spoken. He appointed morning for me; He added an ear for me to hear,
source_units.display_text: The Lord gives me a tongue of instruction, to know the right time when a word must be spoken. He appointed morning for me; He added an ear for me to hear,

source_units.text: and the Lord’s instruction opens my ears. I do not disobey or contradict.
source_units.display_text: and the Lord’s instruction opens my ears. I do not disobey or contradict.

source_units.text: I have given my back to scourges and my cheeks to slaps. I did not turn my face away from the shame of spitting.
source_units.display_text: I have given my back to scourges and my cheeks to slaps. I did not turn my face away from the shame of spitting.

source_units.text: The Lord became my helper; therefore I was not abashed. Instead, I set my face like solid rock and knew that I would certainly not be ashamed.
source_units.display_text: The Lord became my helper; therefore I was not abashed. Instead, I set my face like solid rock and knew that I would certainly not be ashamed.

source_units.text: For the One who justified me draws near. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him stand against me together. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him approach me.
source_units.display_text: For the One who justified me draws near. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him stand against me together. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him approach me.

source_units.text: Behold, the Lord helps me. Who will harm me? Behold, all of you will grow old like a garment, and it will devour you like a moth.
source_units.display_text: Behold, the Lord helps me. Who will harm me? Behold, all of you will grow old like a garment, and it will devour you like a moth.

source_units.text: Who among you fears the Lord? Let him listen to His servant’s voice. Those walking in darkness have no light; trust in the Lord’s name and lean upon God.
source_units.display_text: Who among you fears the Lord? Let him listen to His servant’s voice. Those walking in darkness have no light; trust in the Lord’s name and lean upon God.

source_units.text: Behold, all of you burn fire and strengthen a flame. Walk by your fire’s light and the flame you kindled. These things came to you because of Me; you will fall asleep in sorrow.
source_units.display_text: Behold, all of you burn fire and strengthen a flame. Walk by your fire’s light and the flame you kindled. These things came to you because of Me; you will fall asleep in sorrow.

source_units.text: “Listen to Me, you who pursue what is right and seek the Lord. Look at the solid rock you quarried and the hollow of the pit you dug.
source_units.display_text: “Listen to Me, you who pursue what is right and seek the Lord. Look at the solid rock you quarried and the hollow of the pit you dug.

source_units.text: Look at Abraham your father and Sarah who labored to bear you. He was one, and I called him, blessed him, loved him, and multiplied him.
source_units.display_text: Look at Abraham your father and Sarah who labored to bear you. He was one, and I called him, blessed him, loved him, and multiplied him.

source_units.text: I will now comfort you, Zion; I have comforted all her deserted places and will make her deserted places like the Lord’s paradise. They will find joy and exultation in her, thanksgiving and a voice of praise.
source_units.display_text: I will now comfort you, Zion; I have comforted all her deserted places and will make her deserted places like the Lord’s paradise. They will find joy and exultation in her, thanksgiving and a voice of praise.

source_units.text: Listen to Me, listen, My people; and kings, give ear to Me. For law will go out from Me, and My judgment as a light for nations.
source_units.display_text: Listen to Me, listen, My people; and kings, give ear to Me. For law will go out from Me, and My judgment as a light for nations.

source_units.text: My righteousness approaches swiftly, and My salvation will go out like light. Nations will hope in My arm; islands will wait for Me and hope in My arm.
source_units.display_text: My righteousness approaches swiftly, and My salvation will go out like light. Nations will hope in My arm; islands will wait for Me and hope in My arm.

source_units.text: Lift your eyes to heaven and look at earth below. Heaven was made firm like smoke, but earth will grow old like a garment, and earth’s inhabitants will die like these. My salvation will last for ever, and My righteousness will never fail.
source_units.display_text: Lift your eyes to heaven and look at earth below. Heaven was made firm like smoke, but earth will grow old like a garment, and earth’s inhabitants will die like these. My salvation will last for ever, and My righteousness will never fail.

source_units.text: Listen to Me, you who know judgment, My people with My law in your heart. Do not fear people’s reproach or be overcome by their contempt.
source_units.display_text: Listen to Me, you who know judgment, My people with My law in your heart. Do not fear people’s reproach or be overcome by their contempt.

source_units.text: For a garment will be consumed by time, and wool eaten by a moth. But My righteousness will last for ever, and My salvation through generations of generations.”
source_units.display_text: For a garment will be consumed by time, and wool eaten by a moth. But My righteousness will last for ever, and My salvation through generations of generations.”

source_units.text: You forgot God who made you, who made heaven and founded earth, and feared continually, every day, the face of your oppressor’s anger. For as he planned to remove you—where now is your oppressor’s anger?
source_units.display_text: You forgot God who made you, who made heaven and founded earth, and feared continually, every day, the face of your oppressor’s anger. For as he planned to remove you—where now is your oppressor’s anger?

source_units.text: For I am your God, who stirs the sea and makes its waves resound; the Lord Sabaoth is My name.
source_units.display_text: For I am your God, who stirs the sea and makes its waves resound; the Lord Sabaoth is My name.

source_units.text: I will put My words in your mouth and shelter you under My hand’s shadow, by which I established heaven and founded earth; and He will say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’
source_units.display_text: I will put My words in your mouth and shelter you under My hand’s shadow, by which I established heaven and founded earth; and He will say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’

source_units.text: Awake, awake, rise, Jerusalem, you who drank the cup of anger from the Lord’s hand. You drank out and emptied the cup of falling, the bowl of anger.
source_units.display_text: Awake, awake, rise, Jerusalem, you who drank the cup of anger from the Lord’s hand. You drank out and emptied the cup of falling, the bowl of anger.

source_units.text: There was no one to comfort you among all your children you bore, and no one to take your hand among all your sons you raised.
source_units.display_text: There was no one to comfort you among all your children you bore, and no one to take your hand among all your sons you raised.

source_units.text: These two confront you—who will grieve with you?—fall and crushing, famine and sword. Who will comfort you?
source_units.display_text: These two confront you—who will grieve with you?—fall and crushing, famine and sword. Who will comfort you?

source_units.text: Your sons are helpless, sleeping at every way out like a half-boiled beet, full of the Lord’s anger, exhausted because of the Lord God.
source_units.display_text: Your sons are helpless, sleeping at every way out like a half-boiled beet, full of the Lord’s anger, exhausted because of the Lord God.

source_units.text: Therefore listen, humbled one, drunk but not from wine.
source_units.display_text: Therefore listen, humbled one, drunk but not from wine.

source_units.text: Thus says the Lord God who judges His people: ‘Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of falling, the bowl of anger. You will not drink it again.
source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord God who judges His people: ‘Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of falling, the bowl of anger. You will not drink it again.

source_units.text: I will throw it into the hands of those who wronged and humbled you, who told your soul, “Bend down, so we may pass.” You laid your back level with the earth, outside for passersby.’”
source_units.display_text: I will throw it into the hands of those who wronged and humbled you, who told your soul, “Bend down, so we may pass.” You laid your back level with the earth, outside for passersby.’”

source_units.text: Awake, awake, Zion! Clothe yourself with your strength, Zion, and put on your glory, Jerusalem, holy city. No uncircumcised and unclean person will pass through you again.
source_units.display_text: Awake, awake, Zion! Clothe yourself with your strength, Zion, and put on your glory, Jerusalem, holy city. No uncircumcised and unclean person will pass through you again.

source_units.text: Shake off the dust and rise; sit, Jerusalem. Strip off the bond around your neck, captive daughter Zion.
source_units.display_text: Shake off the dust and rise; sit, Jerusalem. Strip off the bond around your neck, captive daughter Zion.

source_units.text: For thus says the Lord: “You were sold for nothing, and without silver you will be ransomed.”
source_units.display_text: For thus says the Lord: “You were sold for nothing, and without silver you will be ransomed.”

source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “My people formerly went down to Egypt to live there as strangers, and they were forcibly led to the Assyrians.

source_units.text: And now, why are you here?” Thus says the Lord. “My people were taken for nothing. Be amazed and wail!” Thus says the Lord. “Because of you, My name is continually blasphemed among the nations.
source_units.display_text: And now, why are you here?” Thus says the Lord. “My people were taken for nothing. Be amazed and wail!” Thus says the Lord. “Because of you, My name is continually blasphemed among the nations.

source_units.display_text: Therefore My people will know My name on that day, because I am the One speaking. I am present

source_units.display_text: like beauty on the mountains, like the feet of one proclaiming a report of peace, like one bringing good news. For I will make your salvation heard, saying, ‘Zion, your God will reign.’”

source_units.display_text: Let Jerusalem’s deserted places break out in joy together, for the Lord had mercy on her and rescued Jerusalem.

source_units.display_text: Depart, depart; go out from there, and do not touch anything unclean. Go out from her midst; separate yourselves, you who carry the Lord’s vessels.

source_units.display_text: For you will not go out in turmoil or travel in flight, because the Lord will go ahead of you, and the One gathering you is the Lord, Israel’s God.

source_units.text: We all, like sheep, have gone astray; each person has strayed in his own way. And the Lord delivered him over to our sins.

“Rejoice, barren woman who does not give birth! Break out and cry aloud, you who do not labor in childbirth, because the deserted woman’s children are more numerous than those of the woman who has a husband,” for the Lord has spoken.
